title: Accessibility Statement
content:
Insight The City and ITC Club

**Last updated:** October 21, 2026

# 1. Our Commitment and Scope

Eventland LLC, based in New Jersey, United States, operates the Insight The City app and ITC Club.

We aim to make the app usable by people with disabilities and to address barriers that affect access to its information, benefits, and services. We welcome feedback about difficulties using the app.

This statement covers the Insight The City mobile app, including account access, place and benefit information, membership management, QR benefits, Yorki, and account settings.

# 2. Current Accessibility Assessment

Our technical review dated October 21, 2026 examined app code and configuration. It did not include hands-on testing with VoiceOver, TalkBack, voice control, external keyboards, switch controls, or people using assistive technologies. A formal conformance assessment was not completed as part of that review.

**Compatibility with specific assistive technologies and completion of the app's main tasks using those technologies have not yet been verified through end-to-end testing.**

The information below describes implemented features, identified limitations, and areas that still require testing. Some behaviors may differ by device, operating system, language, and app version.

# 3. Features and Known Limitations

- **Screen readers:** Accessible labels and control information are implemented in parts of the app. Coverage, reading order, focus in pop-up windows, and announcements of errors and status changes have not been fully checked in use. New Yorki replies may not be announced automatically.
- **Larger text:** Layouts have not been tested at 200% enlargement or the largest system text sizes. Some layouts and shortened text fields may limit access to enlarged content.
- **Contrast and color:** Selected solid-color combinations have been checked for contrast. A full assessment of screens, interaction states, images, and overlays has not been completed. Text and icons supplement color in several areas, but coverage has not been verified throughout the app.
- **Place information:** Place details can include a written address and links to external mapping services. Available address information depends on the business's records; complete text details for every branch have not been verified.
- **Motion and introductory video:** Reduced-motion handling is implemented in selected screens and banners, with incomplete coverage of Yorki animations. The muted introductory video has no pause control, separate transcript, or audio description. It is designed to be skipped when the system's Reduce Motion setting is enabled; behavior across devices still requires testing.
- **QR benefits:** The QR screen includes instructions and validity information. The displayed reference is not an authorized alternative for manual redemption. The screen does not show the exact expiration time or update redemption status live. Using this screen with a screen reader has not been verified.
- **Other interaction methods:** Voice control, keyboard navigation, and switch controls have not been tested. Some smaller controls and alternatives to gestures require further evaluation.
- **Reported Android issues:** Reports include difficulty returning from saved items and the app closing when opening the profile screen. In the affected circumstances, this can prevent access to account or membership settings. Resolution of these reports has not yet been confirmed. Please contact the ITC team by email if you encounter these difficulties.

# 4. Request Assistance or Report a Barrier

If you experience an accessibility barrier or need help using the app, email **info@insightthecity.com** with the subject **"Accessibility Support."**

**A member of the ITC team will review accessibility requests. You can contact us by email without signing in to the app or using Yorki.**

Where possible, include:

- The screen or feature you were trying to use and the task you wanted to complete.
- What happened and how it prevented or made it difficult to complete the task.
- Your device, operating system, and app version.
- Any relevant accessibility setting or assistive technology you were using.
- The assistance or information format that would help you.

You do not need to provide a diagnosis, medical records, or proof of a disability. Please do not send passwords, full payment card details, or unnecessary sensitive information.

We will review the issue, request relevant additional details if needed, and coordinate follow-up with the appropriate team member. We will consider practical assistance or another way to access the information or complete the task where available.

# 5. External Platforms and Physical Experiences

Some app functions open external services, including Stripe payment and billing screens, mapping services, and partner booking or purchasing platforms. Their accessibility has not been verified as part of our current review of the app.

If an external step creates a barrier, you may contact our team and the operator of that service for assistance. ITC will review concerns involving the information, controls, or integration it provides.

For physical access information, such as step-free entry, accessible seating, or facilities at a venue, contact the business or organizer directly. A listing or ITC Club benefit does not establish that ITC has verified every physical accessibility feature.

# 6. Updates and Contact

We will update this statement as verified information about accessibility features, limitations, or testing results changes. The date above identifies the latest update.

**Eventland LLC**

Operator of Insight The City and ITC Club

New Jersey, United States

**Accessibility contact:** info@insightthecity.com
